checklist.root_identity: AuthorityTransaction::begin (Storage/AuthorityTransaction.php:27-37) binds one new capability to the Storage, the pending DatabaseTransactionRecord whose connection name matches and level is exactly 1, transactionLevel()===1, getPdo(), and Fiber::getCurrent(). assertActive (39-48) requires that same record object (===), the same Fiber, transactionLevel()>=1, getRawPdo() identity, PDO::inTransaction(), and active. close() (50-53) clears the attempt. Storage::perform (Storage.php:262-265, 298-302) installs the marker only when mutate() saw transactionLevel()===0 (227) and removes it in finally.
checklist.recognition_bypass: An already-open Laravel transaction makes mutate() nested, so perform does not call begin(); withinAuthorityTransaction (101-110) refuses level!=0 or a resolved PDO already in a transaction. StorageReadSession (34-37, 123-142) throws authority_transaction when DB authority is consumed with no live marker, including another Fiber, an unlocked panel (Storage.php:84-93, state() at StorageReadSession.php:112-116), or a root record replaced at the same depth. ReadAttempt (85-90, 102, 149, 231) recognizes the marker before any contribution or state-memo read and skips both caches for every contribution on that consumed attempt. PrepareStage.php:131 attaches a ReadAttempt only for Grants; AccessPipeline.php:39-45 leaves an early before veto on an unbegun attempt, so PolicyOnly, code/relation-only, and early veto do not gain this guard.
checklist.publication: Tentative contributions are omitted from ReadAttempt pending (149-151). confirm() (158-194) rechecks the marker before rememberState/put, and both are skipped while a marker is present. The dynamic overlay stays on the attempt. StorageTouched is registered with afterCommit only after the root work returns and only for a non-empty touch set (Storage.php:278-287).
checklist.nested_rollback_retry: Version increment and the touch event run only when StorageMutation parent is null, once per panel key (274-287). Nested failure restores the prior lock and touch maps (293-297) and does not register afterCommit callbacks, which are taken only after work() returns (288-290). Root finally always closes that attempt's marker (298-309) before the Laravel callback returns, so a deadlock retry (mutate 228-244, DetectsConcurrencyErrors) starts a new record and a new marker; the closed marker fails assertActive. No-op leaves pending touches empty, so version and the event stay unchanged.
checklist.touch: The post-commit listener (AzGuardServiceProvider.php:57-61) calls PermissionSetCache::forgetPanel (34-46) on the scoped cache. That drops request sets recorded for the panel, including code-derived Request entries, which put() (109-111) keeps in memory only. Invalidation is therefore after root commit. A DB attempt that is still open bypasses those memos directly.
checklist.incarnation: PermissionSetCache::key (49-57) namespaces StateToken entries by storage, panel, incarnation, version, generation, and fingerprint. A later cold read of a restored lower version under a new incarnation, fingerprint, or generation addresses a different key. StateRefresh::Request memo (ReadAttempt.php:227-233) is defined to keep the warm token for the request; Check does not, and a committed touch forgets the panel memo.
checklist.host_live_inputs: withinAuthorityTransaction delegates Authorizer.php:41-49 to DatabaseSource.php:265-269 and Storage::mutate, which lockPanel (348-360) before the host closure. Recognized Default sessions pin getPdo() (StorageReadSession.php:39). Each decide() resolves the subject again in PrepareStage before conditions run. Host Project/membership lock order stays with the host.
checklist.test_strength: Diff tests cover tentative revoke then rollback, one root version for nested commits, savepoint touch/callback rollback, Default write PDO plus dynamic overlay, tentative Allow under an unchanged token, code Request touch only after commit, no-op and rolled-back touch, joint lock and live subject updates, unknown and already-open entry, Fiber and unlocked panel, same-depth rollback/begin replacement, early veto, incarnation/generation restore through StorageSchema drop/create, P10b, and P16's 200-seed split asserting 50 commit/no-op/retry/rollback with a new marker on retry. Architecture allowlist adds only Authorizer (ZonesArchTest.php:278).

residual_limits: Laravel framework sources are not in this snapshot. Nested afterCommit discard-on-rollback and the deadlock message list are the documented manager/trait contracts the code calls, not files re-read here.
ModelSubjectResolver was not opened. PrepareStage resolves the subject on every decide(); a resolver-local memo, if one exists, is unverified.

StateRefresh::Request keeping a warm token until a new request, Check refresh, or a committed touch is the documented request window. Incarnation-keyed store lookup still changes when a cold read observes the new token.
forgetPanel clears scoped memo entries. Durable Stable DB entries stay isolated by the version/incarnation/fingerprint/generation key. P4.21 owns cross-process and replica qualification.
P6.1 public facade and P6.6 reset/restore commands are absent by scope. Schema drop/create in the restore tests is the local fixture, not those commands.

Raw PDO or an explicit commit/rollback of the Laravel root inside the callback is outside the supported host protocol. The marker then fails closed; SQL already committed by that unsupported call is outside this item.

A Storage::mutate entered from an unknown outer transaction does not install a marker. If that mutate touches and the outer transaction later commits, the version bump commits with it; consumed reads on that attempt stay unrecognized.
In-memory lock bookkeeping is cleared in finally while the driver row lock is still held by the open Laravel transaction until that transaction commits.
